condition: updatemenus and annotations defined in a layout Template do not show up in the Python fig.layout.updatemenus or fig.layout.annotations lists. Those lists stay empty because plotly.js applies template array items when it renders the figure.
workaround: After setting the template, copy the items onto the figure explicitly with fig.update_layout(updatemenus=tpl.layout.updatemenus, annotations=tpl.layout.annotations).
